parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! Experiment with increased DEPTH to 6 yielded val_bpb 0.870676. The model capacity gain significantly outweighs the loss in optimizer steps. I'll continue exploring model capacity and depth, possibly combined with aspect ratio adjustments.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity by increasing DEPTH to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if the performance gain from depth scales with a wider aspect ratio.
